english.notes:
(i) Section 136 of the Sexual Offences At 2003 was Inserted, in relation to England, Wales and Northern Ireland, by section 21(1) of and paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to the Policing and Crime Act 2009.
(ii) The Closure notice must be signed by a police officer of at least the rank of SUPERINTENDENT before a Closure Notice may be issued
(iii) See section 136B(2), (6) and (7) of the Sexual offences Act 2003 for the three condition that MUST exist before a Closure Order must be issued
(iv) See section 136C of the Sexual offences Act 2003 for the content and service of a Closure Notice.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fifty one weeks imprisonment OR a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
